title: Made this cinematic game trailer in Unity in less than a day. What do you think?
author: MohmedHaftari
selftext:
I challenged myself to create a cinematic game trailer from scratch in Unity in less than a day, with only a few hours to actually put it together.

I built the environment, handled the lighting, camera work, and cutscenes, and assembled everything myself. For the 3D assets, I experimented with Tripo AI to see how much I could achieve within such a short timeframe.

I'd love to hear your thoughts on the results, especially the quality of the AI-generated assets and how well they fit into the scene.

What do you think of the results? Anything you'd improve or approach differently?

**See how I built it**: [https://youtu.be/zDbb2lkgtJo](https://youtu.be/zDbb2lkgtJo)
